definition: pSeven SAS is a software development company, evolved out of several simulation and optimization projects performed for Airbus divisions in the early 2000’s.
details: pSeven SAS operates on the market of PIDO software and collaborative engineering environments. Company is founded in 2010 as a joint venture with Airbus. In 2016 pSeven SAS team redeemed Airbus’s share in the company and became independent.
story: Picture a child pointing at pictures in a book — cat, car, cloud — learning to see by seeing a thousand examples. It turns a picture into an understanding: this is a cat, that is a stop sign. What your eyes do without thinking, the machine does one careful layer at a time. It is eyes made of arithmetic — pixels become edges, edges become shapes, shapes become meaning. That pixel-to-meaning climb is PSeven SAS.
